contradicted.evidence: 'mesh runs pass' is wrong: the glm_e12 shape (H 4096, I 2048, 12 experts, 64 tokens each) hung on the full 8x4 FABRIC_2D mesh too (probe glm_mesh84, before the fix). The mesh tests that passed only used plans without the SE_DYN_PULL path (reader tails, or a combine attached). Cause found: se_dyn.hpp compared my_x[0] / my_y[0] (BH firmware reads NOC_ID_LOGICAL = translated coords) with SE_DYN_LPX / LPY = flat_worker_noc0 (physical NoC0). On this card physical column 1 is harvested (triage: logical (0,5) = physical 2-7), so reader 0 (0,9) is physical (2,11), translated (1,11): no leader, every core polled SE_DYN_LSEM forever (triage: 36.9M completed reads on the pollers). MIMO_FL_DYN_PULL=0 passes; the fix (logical-coordinate leader check) passes single chip and 8x4.

on a Galaxy chip the k2 indexed_perf band fails as well (1573274 / 1575501 ns vs upper 1572413; k2 has reader tails, so it never takes the changed path; FIX.1 measured 1573083 before), and the mimo band fails SLOW (1843456 / 1838520 ns vs upper 1826488), not fast as on the QuietBox (1710341 < 1720090): the bands are QuietBox p150 timings

overseer.evidence: Root cause from tt-triage (glm_e12 on one Galaxy chip, 5 s dispatch timeout): every role core polled reader 0's SE_DYN_LSEM forever (se_dyn_load, SE_DYN_PULL) because the leader check compared translated my_x with a physical NoC0 coordinate. Fixed in the fork (program factory + se_dyn.hpp: the leader compares logical coordinates). tests/unit/ on one Galaxy chip: 24 passed / 14 failed / 3 skipped (mesh-only tests), no hangs (was 11 hangs). 12 failures = TT_FATAL p.nsg == 1, the same 12 as the QuietBox baseline (DS41-63). 2 perf bands (mimo, k2 indexed_perf) are NOT identical to the baseline: timing calibrated on the QuietBox p150, slow by +0.7 % / +0.05-0.2 % past the upper bound on the Galaxy chip; not adjusted (a per-box band would special-case the box). The 4 builder asserts (flat_expert.py _layout, grid == 11 x 10) now derive the grid and the east reader column from the device; test_flat_routed_expert_op mimo / k2 pass on the 12 x 10 grid (C++ plan == Python layout). test_flat_widths' I 2304 Galaxy skip removed (passes). The glm shape that hung on the 8x4 mesh passes there too. Not run on the 2x2 QuietBox (not on this box): on a p150 with physical column 1 present the old and new leader checks select the same core, so the QuietBox runs the same schedule.
no padding or extra work: the fix is a coordinate comparison in the fork; no test or shape was changed to avoid the hang
